description: This source file defines the `StorageHasherPicker` class implementing the `IStorageHasherPicker` interface. It manages a collection of hash providers (`IHasher`) and provides functionality to pick one based on certain parameters.

classes.name: StorageHasherPicker
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of hash providers and provides a method to select a hash provider for storage purposes.

methods.name: StorageHasherPicker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection of hash providers; throws ArgumentNullException if the input is null.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Method to select an `IHasher` from the available hash providers; currently returns the first provider or null if none are available.
